ecosystem.description: The state-regulated carrier-licensing layer of the Insurance Industry Ecosystem: an insurance carrier self-issues a license-application ACDC to the state Department of Insurance with jurisdiction, which reviews it and issues a carrier_license credential chaining back to the exact adjudicated application. Closed by design — participation requires an accepted regulator AID and adopted schema SAIDs. Open layers built atop licensed carriers (e.g. contractor networks) are acknowledged as a future seam, not modeled here.

governance.transition_plan: As each state DOI incepts and publishes its AID, its authorities[] entry moves bootstrap→production; verifiers accept both phases during declared migration windows.

roles.description: Licensed risk-bearing entity seeking authority to underwrite named lines of business in a jurisdiction. Self-issues a carrier_license_application ACDC and presents it to the licensing state Department of Insurance; on approval, holds the resulting carrier_license credential.
State Department of Insurance. Reviews and adjudicates carrier license applications, issuing the carrier_license credential that authorizes an insurance carrier to bear risk in its jurisdiction.

authorities.phase_note: Operator-controlled stand-in until the Utah DOI incepts its own AID
